title: CatalogBranch
responsibility: Stores Git branch heads in catalog_branches through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogBranch.id
inputs.description: Caller-supplied row ID for a catalog_branches record, used by lookup, update, and deletion. The model also forwards it on creation and does not generate or validate an ID.

inputs.name: CatalogBranch.head
inputs.description: Branch head value stored as a string on the row. The model forwards it without validating commit syntax.

outputs.name: CatalogBranch.find
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the CatalogBranchAttributes value or null returned by adapter.find for the supplied ID. The model passes the adapter result through unchanged.

outputs.name: CatalogBranch.findBy
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the CatalogBranchAttributes array returned by adapter.findBy. The model supplies a shallow copy of fields and returns the adapter result unchanged.

outputs.name: CatalogBranch.create
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the CatalogBranchAttributes value returned by adapter.create for a shallow copy of input. The model does not generate a row ID or validate attributes.

outputs.name: CatalogBranch.update
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the CatalogBranchAttributes value or null returned by adapter.update for the supplied ID and shallow-copied patch. The model does not apply or validate the patch itself.

outputs.name: CatalogBranch.delete
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the boolean returned by adapter.delete for the supplied ID. The model does not reinterpret the result.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Exceptions thrown by adapter methods and rejections from their returned promises propagate without translation. Shallow-copying fields or inputs in findBy, create, or update can also propagate an exception from an enumerable getter.

inputs.name: CatalogBranch.find.adapter
inputs.description: Persistence adapter supplied for this lookup; the method calls its find operation for catalog_branches. The model does not construct or manage the adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogBranch.find.id

outputs.name: CatalogBranch.find
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the CatalogBranchAttributes value or null returned by adapter.find for the supplied ID. The model passes the adapter result through unchanged.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
